Context: - Section 80-D

- (i) Special deduction of actual expenditure limited to t 40,000 to the patient or a dependant suffering from Cancer or AIDS involving considerable expenditure on treatment and t 1,00,000 if such a dependant is a senior citizen, i.e., who is of the age of 60 years or more. This will, however, be subject to deduction of any amount received through medical insurance, if any. - Section 80-DDB
